title: Events: the feature and map lead, the Around you line and Search sit under them, the grid is three wide

source.ref: Owner design changes list 2026-10-19, Events items 9 to 12 (plan: changed-plan/build-plan-2026-10-19.md, Phase 2)

detail: Owner list 2026-10-19 items 9 and 11. The Around you heading, summary line and pulse strip moved from above the spotlight to a compact row under the feature, map and trio. The one sticky toolbar (search, view, More) now follows the feature and People to meet, so a search or filter (which turns the feature off) still puts it right under the header. The library grid is three columns on desktop, two on tablet, one on a phone.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const b=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/events/events-body.tsx','utf8');const c=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/members-events.css','utf8');const a=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/events/around-you.tsx','utf8');if(a.indexOf('ay-line')<a.indexOf('ay-top'))bad.push('Around you line is above the feature');if(b.indexOf('className=\"ev-tb\"')<b.indexOf('<FqAroundYou'))bad.push('search toolbar is above the feature');if(!/\.ev-list3\{grid-template-columns:repeat\(3,/.test(c))bad.push('grid is not 3 wide');if(!b.includes('ev-list ev-list3'))bad.push('grid is not 3 wide');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1014: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the Around you line or the search toolbar returns above the feature, or the library grid is not three wide on desktop.
